Championship
Championship 26-27
Witness the crowning of the best ONE PIECE CARD GAME player, the Card Game Pirate King!
What is ONE PIECE CARD GAME Championship 26-27?
It is the world biggest tournament for the ONE PIECE CARD GAME.
Win the preliminaries and become the Card Game Pirate King!!
OUTLINE
Check here for full image

Level 1 of the journey is participating in Regionals Season 1 or Season 2 to win your way up to the second level. Regionals Season 1 takes place from March to July 2026 and Season 2 takes place from August to December 2026.
*Store Championship is held only in North America and Europe.
Level 2 is area Finals, which will be held in the end of each Season. If you win here you'll advance to Level 3, the WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP FINALS.
*Finals Season 1 is held only in North America, Europe, and Latin America.
*Finals Season 2 is held in all regions.
*Event dates and details are subject to change.
*Whether an invite is required or it is Open Finals varies depending on the region.
*In Latin America the winners of Finals Season 1 and Finals Season 2 will compete to decide who is invited to the WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP FINALS.
LEVEL 1
Regionals
Overview
Championship Regionals are card battle tournaments to decide the No.1 player in the region.
Become the local Card Game Pirate King and get exclusive treasure!
*In North America and Europe an invite from a Season 1 Regional is only valid for Season 1’s Finals, and an invite from a Season 2 Regional is only valid for Season 2’s Finals.
*Finals invites are only awarded to North America and Europe​ TCG+ players.
*Players will not receive invites at tournaments outside their region.
*For North America and Europe, Finals Championship invites will be passed down to the next highest ranking player if a finalist already has an invite.
*Sales or transfer of admission tickets and invites is strictly forbidden.

*If competitors are found to violate any of these requirements at any time before, during, or after the competition, they will be disqualified from the event, forfeit all prizes, and be subject to further suspensions from BANDAI organized play events.
*The information listed may be subject to change without notice.

Store Championship (NA/EU only)
Store Championship is in person championship events run at selected local stores in North America and Europe!
Become the best at your store and claim your prizes!

*If competitors are found to violate any of these requirements at any time before, during, or after the competition, they will be disqualified from the event, forfeit all prizes, and be subject to further suspensions from Bandai organized play events.
LEVEL 2
Finals
The Championship 26-27 Finals for the ONE PIECE Card Game crowns each region’s Card Game Pirate King and decides who goes on to the World Championship 26-27 in Japan!
This year for North America, Europe and Latin America there will be two Finals tournaments, Season 1 in Sept. 2026, and Season 2 in January 2027.
When the timing matches the Finals will be held at the BANDAI CARD GAMES Fest 26-27 events!
Winners that are joining the Worlds should make sure they have a valid passport and apply for a visa if needed as soon as the dates and their participation are decided.
More details are coming soon!
*North America and Europe each Finals tournament will require an invite, earned at one of the Regionals.
*An invite from a Season 1 Regional is only valid for Season 1’s Finals, and an invite from a Season 2 Regional is only valid for Season 2’s Finals.
*Invited Players will be pre-registered automatically on BANDAI TCG+ and receive a payment code. To participate, please make payment and submit your deck list by the deadline.
*In Oceania and Latin America, Finals tournament which will not require an invite.

*You may participate in events even if you live in another region. However, you must maintain residency in that region in order to represent that region at a World Championship event. If a non-resident wins a Championship Finals event, their World Championship invitation will be passed down to the next highest-ranking resident of that region.
*Prize details are subject to change.
*Prizing and amounts may differ depending on region.
